answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 46911 Country: Pakistan Title: FAST Question: My question is regarding the fast on 9th October 2005 earthquake. My home is located in Mansehra which was highly affected by this earthquake. No one could enter the house on that day to take something for sehr and Iftar. It was a huge calamity. I hope you are aware of this earthquake. I and my family members intentionally did not fast on that day. What is the penalty for that day? Please reply. Answer ID: 46911 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1256/1201/N=9/1434) Those who did not keep fast on the earthquake day, they will have to make qadha of one fast. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
